classification.contradictory_class_action: Exclude if current operator explicitly declares any class other than three; do not upgrade or admit using operator claims.
classification.no_declaration_action: Record no_explicit_class_found and searched operator URLs. Lack of a declaration is not independent confirmation and does not negate an otherwise admissible official record.
classification.check_cadence: At selection and before each collection session; preserve dated results, never overwrite the official evidence date.
classification.age_anchor: Official record effective/as-of date, or identifiable dated official dataset snapshot where record-level award date is absent. Never retrieval/check date, crawl date or unrelated metadata-edit date.
classification.validity: Valid through the 36-calendar-month anniversary, or an earlier stated certificate expiry, whichever comes first. Evaluate at selection, each capture and publication of a current result. Unknown date or age over the ceiling fails.
classification.reasoning: Classification is an administrative category, distinct from a changing room price. A three-year maximum permits the approved roughly 26-month-old official source but prevents indefinite reuse. The counter-check can detect contrary claims, not prove no change. The limit is an editorial risk tolerance, not a measured stability estimate.
classification.expiry_action: Seek newer independent evidence. Without it, withhold current class-qualified results; retain historical observations with their original dates. Do not silently replace panel members or reset the age using an operator declaration.
classification.notice: Three-star classification recorded in regional data last updated 30 September 2024. Operator sites checked 18 November 2026 for contradictory class claims; this does not renew the official classification or establish a current award.

algorithm: Use unrounded Haversine distance, Earth radius 6371008.8 m. Among candidates not excluded, find the nearest remaining distance. Form the inclusive window through nearest +50 m, choose its lowest immutable property_id in ASCII order, remove only that winner and repeat. Unknown eligibility in any of the first eight windows blocks selection. Keep all excluded and unreviewed candidates in the audit.
classification_admission: Independent dated regional three-star record required. Operator claims can veto admission, never establish it. Current room/premises identity and operator-direct booking path required.
exclusion_scope: More distant reserves outside the completed cutoff need not be certified; they remain unknown, not excluded. A replacement requires review of its whole new cutoff window.
state: Panel frozen; no room rates collected or published. Collection calendar and capture software have separate release gates.
